analysis:
Both units are historical sections of CHANGELOG.md (lines 1983-2386): v0.9.x release notes with no executable code. The patch excerpt shows the PR's changes sit at head lines 11-176 (v0.10.5 candidate notes), which are outside the units supplied here, so I could not examine them. The rest is pre-existing text rather than newly introduced behavior.

The visible text describes controls already covered by the canonical threat model: SSD prefix-cache TTL raised to 30 minutes (SEC-035 re-acceptance, T-041), SSD write budget raised to 750 GB/day (a wear and availability tunable, not a new at-rest data exposure), App Attest authorization and revocation fencing (T-052, T-053, T-054, T-057), and removal of the unauthenticated earnings lookup (T-031). Because this text is historical, it does not change any trust boundary, and I did not treat it as evidence of a regression.

I found no instructions embedded in the text. I did not verify the changelog's claims against source, since no source was supplied. For the integration pass, the new v0.10.5 section (head lines 11-176) should be checked for claims that diverge from the threat model: MLX pin changes, complete-checkpoint namespace binding to binary and metallib hashes, the `darkbloom sandbox` installer and add-on flow (TB-013, T-061), and the add-on hold socket (TB-012, T-059, T-060). Those lie outside this batch, so I set needs_deeper_review=false only for these two units.
